title: Emacs Rocks! Episode 13: multiple-cursors
summary: A four-minute Emacs Rocks screencast demonstrating the multiple-cursors package for Emacs. It shows how editing at many places at once can replace repetitive manual edits.
why: Cited as the canonical demo of multiple cursors and of fluent, efficient Emacs editing.

quote.text: One of the better examples of the usefulness of multiple cursors is from Emacs Rocks
